Palm Tree Music Festival Singapore

Palm Tree Music Festival makes its Singapore debut this weekend, bringing a strong lineup led by Alesso and John Summit. Expect an afternoon-to-night experience with music, food, and a well-produced festival setup.

Known for its more refined format, the festival focuses on smaller crowds, better access, and elevated hospitality. With options from general admission to VIP and table service, it offers a more comfortable way to enjoy a large-scale music event.

🔗 Link: See ticket options
📅 When: Sat, Apr 18, 3 pm - 10:30 pm
💸 Cost: S$190 - S$888
📍 Where: The Meadow, Gardens by the Bay

 

Access US real estate without buying property

 

What’s happening? Groundfloor is promoting its Notes as a simpler route into US real estate credit for investors who want predictable returns without directly buying, managing, or financing property themselves. Its Preferred Note offers accredited investors a 9.25% fixed return over a 6-month term with monthly payouts, while its Signature Notes offer up to 8.25% with 1, 3, and 12-month options.

For foreign investors: For international readers looking for exposure to US residential real estate without the hassle of cross-border property ownership, tenant issues, or long lockups, this is the cleaner pitch. Groundfloor says the Notes are backed by diversified pools of first-lien residential real estate loans, with fixed terms and clearly stated yields.

Track record: Groundfloor says it has operated since 2013 and that since launching Notes in 2018 it has made every scheduled principal and interest payment at maturity on its Notes. The Preferred Note is available to accredited investors only, with a $10,000 minimum and a $10 million cap, while Signature Notes are an option for non-accredited investors with lower minimums and flexible durations.

Lower minimum investment amounts and shorter tenures for Summary readers →

 
 

À TABLE! – From Vines to Wine

This exhibition takes visitors through the process of making wine, from grape growing to the final tasting experience. It explains how climate, soil, and craftsmanship shape each bottle, and why France is known for its wine culture.

The experience ends with a sensory focus, where you learn about aromas, textures, and how to enjoy wine. It’s a simple, self-guided visit suitable for beginners and those curious about wine.

🔗 Link: Reserve guided tour
📅 When: Ends Apr 18, tour slots from 9 am - 6:45 pm
💸 Cost: Free entry & Guided from S$10
📍 Where: La Galerie, Alliance Française de Singapour
